text:
aisha: Quick sync — final prep before we flip orion-v2 on Dedicated. Need last checks on weights location, tokenizer quirks, config lint, and one golden/toolcall smoke.

marco: Weights are uploaded: s3://redwood-models/orion/v2/weights-2026-03-17.tar.gz  (readable by dedicated-role). perms verified. :white_check_mark:

sam: noted a tokenizer edge in the goldset causing structured output mismatch — non‑breaking spaces and some soft hyphens. Repro:```python
# tokenizer behaviour
>>> tok.encode("Price\u00A0is $5")  # NBSP U+00A0
[101, 4321, ...]  # token boundary differs from regular space
```
This breaks the JSON postprocess in toolcall tests when we compare exact strings.

aisha: Good catch. Can we normalize on ingest or fix eval harness? I prefer harness-level normalization for now so runtime stays untouched.

tasha: I added a normalizer step to the goldset pipeline: strip_nbsp -> replace U+00A0 with space, collapse unicode hyphen variants. Updated config in configs/orion-v2/goldset.yml.

marco: config lint result (snippet):```yaml
rollout_policy: canary
canary_pct: 5
fallback_model: orion-v1-small
quant_profile: int8-dq
```
Lint OK except a warning about batch_size defaulting to 8 (we usually use 4 for low-latency).

aisha: Lower batch_size to 4 for the dedicated low-latency pool. Also enable kv_cache=true in deploy config.

devbot: CI: model-build (orion-v2) passed all smoke checks — unit tests, tokenizer sanity, and weights checksum OK. https://ci.internal/jobs/4521 :robot_face:

marco: I'll run the golden/toolcall smoke now. Command I'm using: `./scripts/run_golden_eval.sh --model s3://redwood-models/orion/v2/weights-2026-03-17.tar.gz --goldset=goldens/toolcall_v2.json --out=artifacts/orion-v2-toolcall-smoke.json`

sam: When you run it, add `--normalize-unicode` flag to match tasha's pipeline change. Also include `--structured-tolerance=levenshtein:3` to be a bit lenient on minor tokenization deltas.

marco: running... pinging here with results. :hourglass:  (will post short summary)

deploy-bot: Deploy-sim: canary sim completed — 5% traffic routing simulated, fallback test passed for injected OOM. Logs: https://deploy-logs.internal/orion-v2/canary-2212345678 :link:

aisha: Thanks. If the smoke passes with normalization + structured tolerance, we greenlight. Who will do the actual canary flip?

tasha: I'll own the gradual canary with ops assist. I'll coordinate times in #eng-oncall. :raised_hands:

marco: golden smoke finished: 52/54 toolcall tests passed. Two failures are trimmed-space mismatches after structured canonicalization. Uploading results: artifacts/orion-v2-toolcall-smoke.json.

sam: Can you paste the two failure examples? quick diff is fine.

marco: Pasted diffs:```diff
- {"action": "charge", "amount": "$5"}
+ {"action": "charge", "amount": "$5\u00A0"}
```
and```diff
- ["open_file", "README.md"]
+ ["open_file", "README.\u2011md"]  # soft hyphen variant
```
I think the normalizer + tolerance covers these.

aisha: OK. Merge the goldset normalization change, re-run smoke to confirm < 3 failures, then tasha triggers canary. :thumbsup:

devbot: Note: add `--goldset-version=2` tag to the eval job for traceability.

marco: Will do. Thanks everyone — will post final smoke pass update in ~10m. :eyes:
